contract.interface:
The rational input supplies a fixed SPD quadratic host H=G^T W G (positive diagonal W), full-row-rank conservation matrix A, independent-column load basis F and M candidate measurements Cx. A query chooses |S|<=k and an explicit rational polyhedron in (C_Sx,a,z), with a nonnegative objective psi having an explicit convex-QP formulation, to minimize x^T Hx+psi subject to Ax=Fa. Arbitrary nonlinear functions are not free optimization oracles. The source proposes q=O([k log(eM/k)+log(1/delta)]/epsilon^2) random response rows plus d load responses, giving one simultaneous 1-delta guarantee for every support and adaptive query: exact local feasibility, relative optimal value and near-optimal feasible extension. Online arithmetic is O(qk^2+kd+d^2) plus one QP in O(k+d+dim z) variables, with its bit complexity charged. This remains a derived unreviewed algorithmic candidate, not a general nonlinear mechanics or unrestricted topology solver.

Mechanism: K=H^-1-H^-1 A^T(AH^-1 A^T)^-1 A H^-1, X=H^-1 A^T(AH^-1 A^T)^-1 F, Q0=X^T H X. The partial energy is a^T Q0 a+(y-D_S a)^T Gamma_S^+(y-D_S a), exactly on y-D_S a in range(Gamma_S), with D_S=C_S X and Gamma_S=C_S K C_S^T; elsewhere it is infinite. This established minimization identity is not the proposed novelty. Random rows are acquired through the unchanged constrained host solver and repaired via jhat=v-TAv with exact rational AT=I before forming stored products. Charged power-of-four normalization, rounding, repair and precision preserve homogeneous constraints exactly and give a relative PSD geometry bound with exact nullspace even near singularity. Independently rounding the stored final products would destroy the promise.

Multiple loads require a repaired frame A Xhat=F and (Xhat-X)^T H(Xhat-X)<=eta^2 Q0. A certified positive lower bound for Q0 and sufficient column-solve precision are acquired at preprocessing; near-dependent loads cost bits. Individual feasible column solves alone fail for cancelling combinations. With repaired Dhat, Qhat and Gammahat, the full affine feasible domain is unchanged and Ehat/E is between (1-eta-2eta^2)/(1+theta) and (1+eta+2eta^2)/(1-theta), uniformly over every feasible a,y. Parameterizing y=Dhat_S a+Gammahat_S t gives an explicit possibly degenerate convex QP without regularization. Nonnegative psi preserves relative guarantees through minimization. A separate origin-feasible passive force-driven value obeys V/kappa<=Vsafe<=V, kappa=(1+theta)/(1-theta); exact active sets/forces near transitions are not certified.

Full-state output is a separate task: sketch vectors alone need not minimize physical energy. Baseline residual refinement with exact conservation repair, followed by exact sketch correction, is claimed to yield a near-optimal state with both constraints exact. Additional work is O(log((p+2)/zeta)[T_base(zeta)+nnz(C_S)+k^2]+Nq+Nd), plus small rational systems and output bits. Every large solve uses the unchanged host; outputting N entries remains paid. General preprocessing charges fixed-host factorization P_base, exact repair P_T and (q+d)[T_base+T_T+nnz(G)+nnz(C)] plus p d^2; local storage O(M(q+d)+d^2), with additional O(N(q+d)) for field recovery. Online randomness is absent; preprocessing uses pq fair signs. Stored-number bit lengths, right inverses, small eigenvalues/output multiplier bits and local QP description size are not assumed constant.

A source-model application is an elastic truss in complementary force variables, H=diag(ell_e/(E_e a_e)). Local queries include tension-only/capacity/removal constraints, nonnegative additional compliance, squared-hinge responses and continuous convex capacities. It does not simulate plastic history, infer uncertain geometry/parameters or search all binom(M,k) supports. For specified two-dimensional bounded-range separator layouts and an inexpensive exact equilibrium repair, the reported arithmetic preprocessing is O-tilde(N^(3/2)+Nq), using specialized nested-dissection costs rather than a dense baseline. Fixed known interfaces should use ordinary condensation; the intended advantage requires many adaptive interfaces, q<<M and mostly local outputs. High accuracy may eliminate any crossover.

Failure boundary: exact rational model feasibility is not exact physical feasibility under uncertain inputs. Negative quadratic corrections that cancel baseline energy can magnify error by theta/rho even when the final model remains convex; globally changing constitutive geometry and nonconvex instability require another representation. The supplied diagnostics report largest reduced-design true-objective ratio about1.00814, feasibility residual about1.3e-16, one recovery energy ratio about1.0000000246 and worst sketch geometry distortion about35.9%. The 64-row sketch is larger than the six-state host. Floating optimization diagnostics are distinct from exact algebra; no compression/performance at scale, full tolerance guarantee, independent correctness or major established capability is demonstrated.

failed_attempts.attempt: Per-load feasibility and individual solve accuracy imply uniform multi-load energy accuracy
failed_attempts.failure_scope: For near-cancelling loads a=(1,-1), exact energy rho^2 becomes rho^2+4eta^2 in an individually accurate feasible frame; a Q0-relative matrix error is required.

failed_attempts.attempt: Exact feasibility handles arbitrary bulk modifications
failed_attempts.failure_scope: Subtracting (1-rho)y^2 from a baseline y^2 approximated as (1+theta)y^2 leaves relative error theta/rho. Nonnegative local penalties are covered; cancellation, arbitrary geometry changes and near-buckling bulk models are not.

failed_attempts.attempt: Sketch vectors are themselves an accurate physical reduced basis
failed_attempts.failure_scope: They preserve the response domain but their lift can have large energy; near-optimal full-state output requires paid baseline refinement and an exact final interface correction.
